The short version

Independent, unhurried, and built around the coffee bar.

Coffeesmith roasts its brewing around a small counter of origin beans, poured as flat whites and rosetta lattes, alongside a kitchen turning out sourdough toasts, grilled sandwiches and cakes baked in-house. Pull up a table by the window, or take it to go.

Menu highlights

What people come back for

A short list of the three things Coffeesmith is best known for — the full board changes with what's baked that morning.

Popular · Bakery

Cakes

Thick-layered, made in-house and changing weekly — from cookies-and-cream to salted biscoff. Ask what's on the stand today.

Popular · Coffee

Flat White

Origin beans from the shelf behind the counter, pulled tight and poured slow. The one regulars order without looking at the board.

Popular · Breakfast

Scrambled Eggs

Soft-scrambled, piled onto sourdough with chives and cracked pepper, served with grilled smoked bacon on the side.
